title: Treasury Manager Cash & Liquidity Management (m/f/d)

title: Senior Software Engineer, Chaos Engineering
description:
Datadog’s Chaos Engineering team builds systems that surface reliability weaknesses before they become outages. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will initially focus on zonal resilience, building automation that helps services safely evacuate and recover from zonal failures, while also contributing to fault injection, incident replay, gameday orchestration, and reliability tooling. You will work across engineering teams to design systems that safely exercise production failure modes and turn findings into verified remediation. You will also help advance the use of AI and automation to identify, test, and close resilience gaps as Datadog’s software and infrastructure evolve.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do:

• Build zonal-resilience automation that coordinates safe workload evacuations, switchovers, and recovery in partnership with the teams that own affected services.

• Design and build fault-injection systems for production environments, including infrastructure- and application-level testing, incident replay, and controlled resilience experiments.

• Develop safeguards such as blast-radius controls, kill switches, validation mechanisms, and rollback paths that keep production experiments contained and reversible.

• Build agents and automation that help propose failure scenarios, triage experiment results, and connect reliability findings to tracked remediation and verification.

• Lead gamedays from hypothesis and scenario design through execution, documented findings, remediation tracking, and validation of completed fixes.

Modash helps brands find, understand, and work with creators across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube. More than 2,700 companies-including Stanley 1913, Sennheiser, and NordVPN-use us to manage and scale their creator partnerships. Every one of those products depends on fresh, reliable creator data. That’s where you come in. Why we're hiring Data Core isn't an internal support team. It owns the collection infrastructure that the entire Modash product-and every downstream data team-depends on. We need a senior engineer who can design resilient services, make thoughtful tradeoffs between coverage, freshness, reliability, and cost, and take production-critical systems from a rough idea to dependable operation. You’ll join the specialised Data Core team and work closely with Data Search, Data Insights, product teams, and company leadership. You’ll have real ownership, but you won’t work in isolation. If you want a feel for how we think about building software, check our Engineering Blog . What you'll actually own 1. Keep creator data flowing at massive scale.

title: API Support Engineer (Tier 3)
description:
Overview
DecisionPoint seeks an API Support Engineer (Tier 3) to troubleshoot and resolve complex API, integration, and data flow issues across enterprise applications within a large federal and DoD-aligned mission environment. This senior troubleshooting role supports escalations from Tier 1 and Tier 2 teams, analyzes integration failures, resolves data mapping discrepancies, and provides in-depth diagnostic support for API consumers and backend systems.
The API Support Engineer serves as a technical escalation point, partnering with developers, integration engineers, cloud engineers, and system owners to restore service, identify root causes, and ensure resilience across enterprise API workflows.
This position is fully remote.
Duties & Responsibilities
The API Support Engineer (Tier 3) will:

• Resolve complex API issues escalated from Tier 1 and Tier 2 support, including endpoint failures, schema mismatches, and authentication problems.

• Triage enterprise-wide API incidents involving integrations, middleware, and downstream systems.

• Diagnose data mapping issues, payload inconsistencies, and transformation logic errors.

• Work closely with development and integration teams to reproduce issues and validate fixes.

• Support incident response by collecting logs, analyzing error patterns, and performing root cause analysis.

• Validate API behavior against OpenAPI/Swagger specifications, schemas, and version requirements.

• Assist in testing API changes, version upgrades, and integration adjustments prior to deployment.

• Document findings, resolutions, and recurring issue patterns in the enterprise knowledge base.

• Participate in Change Control Board (CCB) processes when fixes affect production integrations.

• Provide guidance to application teams on API usage, integration best practices, and troubleshooting steps.

• Work with cybersecurity teams when API issues intersect with authentication, authorization, or data security concerns.

• Support monitoring and alerting improvements for API endpoints and integration workflows.
Qualifications
Clearance Requirement
Must hold an active Top Secret clearance , supported by a Tier 5 background investigation.
Education (Required)
Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
Experience (Required)

• Minimum 6 years of experience in API support, backend troubleshooting, or application technical support.

• Experience diagnosing and resolving API defects, schema mismatches, and integration failures.

• Experience working with JSON schemas, OpenAPI/Swagger specifications, and API documentation.

• Experience troubleshooting authentication and authorization flows (OAuth2, SAML, JWT).

• Experience supporting enterprise IT environments, preferably within federal or DoD missions.
Technical Knowledge (Required)

• Strong knowledge of REST APIs, endpoint communication, and data structures.

• Familiarity with middleware, integration layers, and message brokers.

• Experience analyzing logs from API gateways, application servers, or integration pipelines.

• Understanding of data mapping, transformation, and error-handling logic.

• Familiarity with monitoring tools used for API health and performance.
Technical Knowledge (Preferred)

• Experience with AWS GovCloud integration patterns.

• Knowledge of event-driven architectures or asynchronous API workflows.

• Experience with scripting or automation to support diagnostics.
Certifications

Required:

• ITIL v4 Foundation

• CompTIA Security+
Preferred:

• Additional API or cloud certifications (AWS Developer, API testing, etc.)
Skills

• Strong problem-solving abilities for complex, multi-system issues.

• Excellent communication skills for interacting with developers, engineers, and stakeholders.

• High attention to detail and ability to work through ambiguous technical symptoms.

• Ability to document troubleshooting steps and resolution procedures clearly.

title: Enterprise Solutions Engineer - Colombia
description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

HOW WE WORK

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company-from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

This role is remote but the successful candidate should be based in Brazil.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Solutions Engineer, you'll work as part of a driven team to unlock the full potential of our voice AI platform for a growing customer base. Your mission is to efficiently scale our technical solutions to many enterprise customers, both directly and by improving our internal processes and supporting our sales teams.

description:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

At Vanta, our mission is to secure the internet and protect consumer data. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it.

Our goal is to provide best-in-class Technical Support to our customers. Our team's mission: "We transform complexity into clarity in every interaction, with empathy, earning the trust of our customers" We build strong partnerships with our customers through trust and transparency, which is why our Technical Support Metrics https://www.vanta.com/technical-support-metrics are public.

As the AI Agent Operations Specialist,You'll own Ask-Ilma, Vanta's customer-facing AI agent, built on Fin by Intercom, and the first point of contact for customers seeking support.. You're accountable for whether customers get the right answer, how the experience feels, and how smoothly Fin hands off to our support engineers when it should. Our customers rely on Vanta to get compliance right, so a fast answer only counts if it's also a correct one.

This is a hands-on role for someone who treats an AI agent like a product: something to measure, tune, test, and improve every week.

What you’ll do as a AI Optimization Specialist, Support at Vanta:

PERFORMANCE: OWN HOW WELL FIN WORKS

An AI agent's performance drifts without a clear owner, and that owner is you. You'll have a bias for action, shipping improvements quickly and learning from the results. You'll also decide with frameworks, so the team always understands why one fix came before another.

- Review Fin conversations weekly to find wrong answers, self-service gaps, and avoidable escalations.

- Make changes in Fin yourself (guidance, content, workflows). Treat most as two-way doors: ship, measure, adjust.

- Keep a ranked list of improvements based on customer impact, volume, and risk.

- Set and document Fin's guardrails: what it must never answer, when it asks a clarifying question, and when it escalates.

KNOWLEDGE: OWN WHAT FIN KNOWS

Fin is only as accurate as what it knows. Our customers trust Vanta to get compliance right, and we do what it says on the tin, so Fin's knowledge has to be correct and current.

- Own the knowledge Fin draws from: snippets, internal content, and our help center.

- Set the governance: every topic has an owner and a review cadence, and outdated or conflicting content gets retired.

- When a support engineer answers something Fin couldn't, turn it into reusable knowledge so we only answer it once.

- Set AI-ready content standards, and partner with Customer Education to bring help-center articles up to them.

CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE: OWN HOW FIN FEELS TO CUSTOMERS

For many customers, Fin is the first Vanta "teammate" they talk to. Because we put our customers first, how Fin makes them feel matters as much as what it says.

- Shape how Fin sounds, including how it says "I don't know" without leaving customers stuck.

- Own handoffs: when Fin escalates, where it routes, and what context it passes so customers never repeat themselves.

- Dig into low CSAT ratings and dead ends, and fix the root cause.

- Handle a small volume of tickets to stay close to real customer problems.

LAUNCH READINESS: OWN FIN'S READINESS FOR EVERY LAUNCH

Vanta ships fast, and customers ask about new features the day they launch. We win as one team and lead with resilience, so Fin is ready on day one, even when plans change late.

- Partner early with Product, Engineering, and Customer Education

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Certa (certa.ai http://certa.ai) is an AI-native third-party risk management platform that unifies the full third-party lifecycle, from onboarding through continuous monitoring and offboarding. Enterprises from the Fortune 500 to fast-growing startups use our no-code platform to manage vendors, suppliers, and partners across risk, compliance, and ESG. Trusted by Honeywell, Uber, MARS, and Boeing, we've processed over 10 million entities for 100,000+ users across 120+ countries.

We're hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer to reinvent how Certa gets implemented. Because our no-code Studio lets you configure a workflow simply by describing it - Vibe Configuration℠ - one person can now sit with the customer, understand a requirement as it's spoken, and build it live, so they see their own workflow running in the same session. You'll work directly with Fortune 500 teams across compliance, information security, privacy, legal, procurement, finance, and sustainability - credible enough to discuss vendor-tiering policy with a Chief Procurement Officer, then open Studio and build it. You'll be one of the first people doing this, which means you'll also define how it's done.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Understand the business process: Run discovery and design sessions with Fortune 500 teams across compliance, security, privacy, legal, procurement, finance, and sustainability - often in the same room with competing views - and learn how their third-party processes actually run today, including the parts that live in email, spreadsheets, and people's heads.

- Document & optimize it: Map the current state and agree a target state against the metrics customers actually care about - onboarding cycle time, assessment turnaround, reviewer effort, audit readiness. You're not there to digitize a bad process faithfully, and a workflow that's technically correct but painful to use won't get adopted - so reviewer effort and drop-off are your problem, not theirs.

- Configure & automate it in Certa: Build the workflows, forms, logic, risk scoring, and approvals in Studio using Vibe Configuration℠ - live in the room wherever possible - plus the integrations and data flows into existing systems, and debug them when they break.

- Own the delivery: Own the plan, governance, and test cycle (scenarios and cases, SIT, UAT with the customer's own testers, sanity and regression), then cutover, go-live, hypercare, and a clean handover - accountable for the date and the success metrics behind it.

- Bring learning back from the front lines: Find the platform's real limits before anyone else does and bring them to Product with evidence - the customer, the frequency, the cost of the workaround - and turn what you built into templates and accelerators, so the next deployment starts ahead of where yours did.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

- Experience: 3+ years in customer-facing technical delivery - forward deployed engineering, solutions architecture, implementation consulting, or technical professional services.

- Hands-on technical skills: Comfortable with REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, and data mapping; able to script in Python or JavaScript and debug a failure across two systems you didn't build.

- Production LLM experience: You've worked with LLMs in production rather than in demos - prompts, retrieval, agent workflows, and evaluating output systematically rather than by vibes.

- Product-centric & shipping-biased: You think about the user in front of the screen, not the requirement in the document, and favor shipping something usable and iterating over shipping something perfect and late.

- Delivery fluency: You've carried a go-live date in front of a customer, so project plans, RAID logs, phase gates, test scenarios and cases, SIT, UAT, and regression testing are familiar ground.

- Communication: Thoughtful and streamlined - you listen first, hold your own with a Chief Procurement Officer, privacy counsel, and security architect in the same room, and can say no to a customer

title: GTM Strategy & Operations, AMER Lead
description:
ABOUT FACTORY

Our mission is to create a world where software builds and improves itself.

We build the platform for self-improving software development, helping the world's largest enterprise engineering teams turn their organizations into autonomous software factories. Customers including Nvidia, Blackstone, Royal Bank of Canada (RBC), Palo Alto Networks, Adobe, and T-Mobile run Factory to ship code, review PRs, run tests, and deploy continuously - getting smarter with every cycle.

In 2026, we raised $200M at a $5B valuation, bringing our total funding to over $400M. We are backed by world-class investors and operators including Khosla Ventures, Sequoia, Blackstone, Ali Ghodsi (CEO of Databricks), and Frank Slootman (Former CEO of Snowflake).

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a GTM Strategy & Operations Lead, you will be a founding member of our GTM Strategy & Operations team, embedded as the strategic partner to the sales leaders running our AMER sales organization.

You will own segment performance alongside those leaders: the strategy behind the number, the operating cadence and tactics that drive it, and the analysis that explains what is working and what is not. From forecasting and pipeline management to territory design, capacity planning, quota and incentive structures, and go-to-market strategy, you will touch nearly every lever that makes a sales organization perform.

This is a high-visibility seat at the center of the business. The role is a direct path to a deep understanding of commercial strategy and operational excellence in a high-growth environment.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AND ACHIEVE

- Partner directly with Enterprise, Mid-Market and BDR leadership to define segment strategy, growth priorities, and execution plans.

- Translate company-level goals into segment targets, operating plans, and measurable KPIs.

- Own the forecast for your segments: run the cadence, pressure-test the calls, and give leadership a defensible view of where the quarter lands.

- Lead high-impact analyses that inform critical decisions across pipeline health, conversion, capacity planning, segmentation, incentive design, and headcount investment.

- Build the financial and operating models used to evaluate trade-offs and quantify the impact of GTM decisions.

- Own territory and account coverage design, quota setting, and the mechanics that make both defensible to reps and leadership.

- Design and run the core business cadences that create accountability: weekly pipeline reviews, forecast calls, and QBRs.

- Build the dashboards and reporting infrastructure that give leadership visibility into performance, productivity, and pipeline generation.

- Establish the metrics that distinguish top performers, diagnose the root causes of underperformance, and scale what works across the team.

- Improve Salesforce and the surrounding GTM stack so data integrity, workflow efficiency, and reporting keep pace with the business.

- Project-manage cross-functional initiatives spanning Sales, Marketing, Partnerships, Engineering & Product, Finance, Recruiting, and Operations.

- Find novel ways to use Factory droids to automate the reporting, analysis, and deal support work that would otherwise consume the team.

- Roll up your sleeves on immediate problems while building the long-term infrastructure, and present clear, structured recommendations to senior leadership.

QUALIFICATIONS

- 4+ years of professional experience, ideally in consulting, investment banking, private equity, corporate strategy, or a high-growth startup.

- Strong analytical skills: You go deep on data and structure analyses quickly to answer the business question at hand. You know the data underneath your work, including where it comes from, how it's built, and where it falls short. You can defend your numbers and have a point of view.

- Ownership: You take initiative, drive problems to the finish, bring in the right people at the right time, and hold yourself accountable for the outcome.

title: Senior Commercial Counsel - Government Contracting
description:
ABOUT ABRIDGE

Abridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare. Our AI-powered platform was purpose-built for medical conversations, improving clinical documentation efficiencies while enabling clinicians to focus on what matters most-their patients.

Our enterprise-grade technology transforms patient-clinician conversations into structured clinical notes in real-time, with deep EMR integrations. Powered by Linked Evidence and our purpose-built, auditable AI, we are the only company that maps AI-generated summaries to ground truth, helping providers quickly trust and verify the output. As pioneers in generative AI for healthcare, we are setting the industry standards for the responsible deployment of AI across health systems.

We are a growing team of practicing MDs, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to empower people and make care make more sense. We have offices located in the Mission District in San Francisco, the SoHo neighborhood of New York, and East Liberty in Pittsburgh.

THE ROLE

Abridge’s government business is growing in both volume and complexity, and this role will own the contract product, and compliance work that powers it. We are looking for a seasoned attorney with experience building relationships with and contracting with government agencies. As a Senior Corporate Counsel - Government Contracting, you will be at the front lines of making Abridge a success, working with internal stakeholders across the sales, partner success, security and product teams to support contracting, product development, and compliance with some of our most complex customers.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Drive customer growth by drafting, reviewing, and negotiating complex government contracts, ensuring compliance with Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) and agency specific requirements

- Provide guidance throughout the entire lifecycle of product build and government contracting, from government sales strategy and solicitation review through bid submission, negotiation, to implementation and ongoing regulatory and government contract compliance

- Work with our commercial legal team in iterating on and improving our templates, and developing playbooks and processes for improving accuracy and efficiency

- Facilitate automation and efficiencies in collaboration with our Legal Ops team

- Stay abreast of regulatory and policy developments that may impact decision making

- Work with and manage outside counsel to navigate complex and novel questions

- Please note, while we anticipate the majority of time will be spent supporting government contracting, the exact percentage may vary week-to-week, and this role will be expected to support other aspects of the commercial legal function when core work is slower

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

- 7+ years of experience in a legal function with at least 3 years of advising on working with government contracting and related compliance.

- Established ability to advise on government contract implementation and ongoing compliance, including translating contract obligations into internal processes and assessing adherence to those obligations.

- Comfort with juggling tight timelines, competing priorities, and a high volume of contracts

- Passion for Abridge’s mission and the energy and drive to support a fast-moving commercial team

- A customer-service mindset; we approach our deals as collaborative projects and treat negotiations as a tool to establish strong partnerships with our customers

- Demonstrated ability to work independently; interest in joining a small team that prioritizes autonomy and trust

- Proven ability to work cross-functionally, particularly with technical teams, security, and sales teams, building relationships and earning their confidence

- Creativity in solving and navigating novel contractual matters; experience in crafting new approaches and language to meet the needs of a rapidly-moving enterprise

title: Team Lead, Android Core Product - Houston, TX, USA
description:
Remote
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
Over 50 million people use Speechify 's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading - PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites - into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify 's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.
Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting - Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.
Overview
Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.
This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own - that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.
We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.
What You'll Do

• Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team - from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight

• Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features

• Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval

• Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself

• Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through

title: Research Fellow: AI-moderated Interviews at Scale: The Trust in Healthcare Study
description:
Surgo Health is requesting proposals for research projects building on our dataset focused on the healthcare trust landscape. While declining public trust in the U.S. healthcare system is widely documented through conventional survey methods, the underlying, individual-level drivers of this erosion often remain unclear.

To address this gap, our dataset explores trust dynamics across medical providers, health institutions, social media, and artificial intelligence, while highlighting actionable pathways for restoring confidence. The data encompasses both a detailed questionnaire battery and in-depth qualitative dialogues gathered by Derin®, our AI-moderated interviewing system.

Designed as a randomized, counterbalanced study, the dataset enables direct methodological comparisons between standard survey approaches and AI-moderated conversational interviews. It spans roughly 2,000 respondents across two distinct research panels. It has 6,000 completed interviews alongside extensive survey batteries, standard demographic indicators, and population weighting factors.

We are seeking research proposals that:

•
Advance the narrative on trust & healthcare -contribute to contemporary thinking on this subject in the U.S.

•
Leverage the conversations - projects should examine the reasoning, experiences, or context revealed when respondents elaborate, going beyond what closed items already capture.

•
Use the dataset - research questions should be answerable with the current dataset and not require funding for new data collection

•
Publishable - proposals should aim for peer-reviewed publication, with rigorous methodology.

We encourage proposals that move beyond showing that conversational interviews produce more detail, focusing instead on for whom, under what conditions, and through what mechanisms conversational data adds value. Projects will be given access to the full dataset and documentation, and can integrate external data (such as ACS, provider density, or state health policy indicators) via the harmonized geographic and demographic variables in the dataset.

Research Focus Areas

We welcome proposals in areas below, but also encourage you to submit proposals that are adjacent to these areas.

•
Trust in healthcare - drivers of trust erosion and recovery; public perspectives on AI in healthcare; decisions made against medical advice; institutional versus individual trust; and perceptions of the pharmaceutical industry.

•
Survey methodology - variations in response quality by education, age, income, geography, and political views; order and carry-over effects across modes; effort signatures; construct validity of trust items; and turn-level drop-off in conversational surveys.

•
Interviewer design and conversation dynamics - probing strategies and sequencing; respondent responses (elaboration vs. new disclosures); interviewer neutrality; and managing sensitive disclosures.

•
Computational methods - analysis pipelines for transcript data, including predicting closed-ended responses from conversational text (and vice versa).

Proposals should be 1-2 pages and outline:

•
Core contribution - how the research builds beyond existing literature

•
Use of qualitative data - what insights the conversational responses provide beyond standard closed-ended items.

•
Practical application - key decisions or practice changes informed by the findings.

•
Analytical plan - key variables, panel-specific estimates, and analytical approaches for randomized and observational factors.

•
Publication goals - target journals and expected outputs.

Program Structure

•
Surgo Health will select two to three proposals based on:

• Practical relevance and research depth

• Feasibility with available data

• Alignment with Surgo Health research priorities

• Potential for publication in high-impact journals

Selected projects will receive:

•
Stipend amount: $6,000 in compensation upon successful submission of draft to Surgo

title: Product Manager
description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

We're looking for a Product Manager for Fraud & Risk who wants to understand how fraud really happens and to build products that stop it at scale. You're comfortable with ambiguity and you like hard trade-offs, like loss vs. friction or automation vs. human review. Your decisions rest on data, customer insight and strong cross-functional partnerships. And last, but not least, you know that a team succeeds because of its people, and you want to help build an environment where we can all do our best work.

This is a chance to shape the risk platform behind one of the largest restaurant payments businesses in the US. You'll use machine learning and AI to protect restaurants and help Toast grow. 

Who We Are

The Fraud & Risk team keeps Toast, our restaurants and their guests safe from fraud and financial loss. We also make it fast and easy for restaurants to get onboarded and get paid. The team owns:

• Merchant onboarding and underwriting (KYC/KYB)

• Transaction and payout risk monitoring

• The fraud rules and decisioning platform

• Settlement reserves

• Chargebacks and disputes

Our job is to balance loss prevention against growth. We stop bad actors without adding friction for the great majority of restaurants that are doing the right thing. We work closely with Risk Operations, Payments, Compliance and Legal. We operate like a small startup with high ambitions and a focus on speed, experimentation and iteration.

A day in the life (Responsibilities) 

• Drive and prioritize the roadmap for your area of Fraud & Risk. Balance fraud loss reduction, merchant experience and business growth.

• Set the strategy for detecting and preventing fraud across the merchant lifecycle: onboarding, payments, payouts and disputes.

• Partner with data science and engineering to improve risk models, rules and decisioning. Define the right trade-offs between catching fraud and avoiding false positives.

• Build AI-driven automation that scales our risk and chargeback operations, such as agent-assisted reviews and automated dispute responses.

• Understand the needs of restaurants, their guests and our internal Risk Operations analysts. Use customer conversations, investigations, data analysis, ops feedback and industry intelligence.

• Define and own success metrics such as fraud loss rates, chargeback rates and win rates, auto-approval rates and operational efficiency.

• Work with Compliance, Legal, Payments and external partners such as processors, card networks and risk vendors to deliver solutions that are compliant and scalable.

• Write clear product requirements and work closely with designers and engineers to bring them to life.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

Ramp is hiring its first dedicated Physical Security Lead to build and run the program that protects our people, our leaders, our events, and our offices. Our footprint now spans a multi-floor New York headquarters, Ramp-managed offices, and a growing set of hubs across North America and Europe. Our leaders are increasingly visible on public stages.

This is a high-ownership IC role on the Corporate Security team. It reports to the Director of IT & Corporate Security and is based at our NYC HQ. This is a physical security role; cybersecurity and information security are owned by other Ramp security teams. We aren't looking for a guard supervisor or a box-checker. We want someone who makes it safe for Ramp to move fast, host great events, and keep our leaders accessible.

- Coordination with venues and vendors.

- On-site leadership for the highest-risk events.

- After-action reviews.

- Set Ramp's global physical security standards for access control, video surveillance, intercoms, visitor management, and alarm monitoring. Tier them for headquarters, Ramp-managed offices, and flexible or serviced hub spaces.

- Write the security design requirements and review drawings.

- Manage integrators through installation and acceptance testing.

- Partner with IT on network and identity integration.

- Manage the guard program and security vendors end to end: scope, post orders, SLAs and KPIs, budget, and quarterly business reviews. Own the security relationship with landlords and building management.

- Emergency notifications, evacuation and shelter-in-place plans, and drills.

- Liaison with local law enforcement.

title: Community Engagement Manager, Data Centers (New York)
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic is building AI systems that will shape the trajectory of one of the most consequential technologies in human history. That work requires physical infrastructure at significant scale, and building that infrastructure the right way means being a real, long-term partner to the communities where we operate.

We are looking for a Community Engagement Manager in New York to join our Public Policy team and serve as Anthropic's on-the-ground presence in the communities where our data centers are sited, built, and operated. This is not a communications role or a government affairs role, though you will do elements of both. It is a relationship role: your job is to make Anthropic a trusted, visible, and valued neighbor, from the earliest stages of site selection through construction and long-term operations.

You will be the connective tissue between Anthropic's Policy and Infrastructure teams and the local officials, community organizations, economic development partners, and residents who have a stake in what we build. You will surface concerns before they escalate, translate our technical and operational plans into clear local benefits, and build the coalitions that allow us to move quickly and responsibly. Because Anthropic's infrastructure footprint is still early in its growth, you will also help write the playbook: the processes you build in your first markets are the ones we will use as we expand.

You will travel regularly across New York State, including upstate communities, up to 50% of the time, and occasionally to other Anthropic data center markets.

Key responsibilities

•
Build and maintain trusted, sustained relationships with town, village, city, and county elected officials and administrators, planning and zoning boards, local industrial development agencies, state agencies, economic development organizations, community groups, civic leaders, labor and building trades organizations, educational institutions, and workforce partners in the New York data center markets you cover

•
Develop and execute a community engagement strategy for each of your markets, spanning site selection, pre-development, construction, and ongoing operations

•
Build external coalitions, host education and listening sessions, and design local solutions that deliver real benefits to the communities where we operate

•
Represent Anthropic in public forums, town halls, planning hearings, community events, and local media

•
Monitor community sentiment and local political dynamics, and advise internal teams on risks, opportunities, and the right pace and posture for engagement

•
Partner with the Real Estate and Infrastructure team to bring community input into how projects are planned, communicated, and delivered, not just how they are announced, including public comment and environmental review processes

•

ABOUT US

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands - including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank - to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor https://www.linkedin.com/in/brettaylor/ and Clay Bavor https://www.linkedin.com/in/claybavor/. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.

ABOUT THE FINANCIAL SERVICES TEAM

- Our financial services customers span systemically important banks, neobanks committed to building more delightful banking software (1 in 3 of the world's leading banks use Sierra!), insurers that provide protection for life’s most challenging moments, vertically integrated ecosystems like Rocket Companies, and more. The decisions we make impact millions of end customers and billions of dollars in economic activity.

- Our financial services team partners closely with these organizations to set their AI strategies and build modern tools that carefully handle moments when a person’s private anxiety meets an institution’s procedural muscle - the instant before a family learns whether they are pre-approved for a mortgage; the claustrophobic half hour after someone notices a fraudulent charge; the frustrating experience of losing a card and needing to order a new one.

- Sierra’s Financial Services team is transforming the customer experience and building technology that makes the industry more accessible, human, and affordable for everyone.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Be the primary partner to your Sales counterparts helping to win deals and grow customers

- Go from first discovery to a tailored, working agent in days, not weeks, across prospects and existing customers

- Own the end-to-end technical pre-sales process by scoping customer use cases, articulating business value, designing and demoing Sierra’s incredible platform, leading technical and architecture reviews, and serving as the trusted technical expert throughout the sales cycle

- Work directly with our Sales, Product and Agent Engineering teams to both drive our GTM function, as well as continuously improve our Agents through our customer-driven product development philosophy

- Go deep on your industry, the patterns, and winning motions to scale your work

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

- 3-4+ years experience in Sales Engineering, Solutions Engineering or customer-facing technical sales

- Experience in leading the sales process with Enterprise customers with deal sizes ranging $200-$500k

- Past experience in demo building, and presenting, and working with customers or clients in the GTM function

- Experience in relationship-building with prospects, including executives and technical leaders

- Ability to connect a prospect’s specific business problems and Sierra’s solutions and explain them to both a technical and non-technical audience

title: Strategic Account Director
description:

This role requires a strong background in SaaS and/or healthcare sales, excellent communication and collaboration skills, and a passion for making healthcare accessible to everyone.
Who we are

BioDigital has built the first cloud-based solution for visualizing the human body in interactive 3D. Like Google Earth for the human body, our cutting-edge technology empowers patients, educators, and professionals worldwide with an engaging, visual way to learn about health and medicine. Our team is on a mission to make health and the human body understandable to all, and we’re seeking a talented, customer-centric Strategic Account Director to help execute on our ambitious goals.
Who you are
Ideally, you'll have a proven track record in selling and managing cloud-based software solutions, particularly within healthcare, life sciences, or medical technology. You are skillful and passionate about developing and managing high-value, complex client relationships by deeply understanding their needs, proactively identifying opportunities to expand business within the account, and collaborating cross-functionally to deliver strategic solutions that align with the client's long-term goals. You enjoy collaboration with sales, product, content, and customer success teams to help clients realize the value of our platform. You are detail oriented, a creative problem solver, and have a personal connection to our mission of helping people better understand their health.
What you’ll do

Work closely with internal teams to ensure seamless execution and timely delivery of solutions.

• Build value-based relationships with key executive level decision makers by leveraging existing client relationships and building new ones.

• Represent BioDigital at industry events or trade shows.

What you’ll bring to the role

• 5-10 years experience in a key account director, strategic account director or enterprise sales role.

title: Business Process Manager, Partner Ecosystem
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE:

Everpure goes to market through partners, and every partner interaction depends on a business process: how a partner is onboarded, how program compliance is done, how exceptions are submitted, reviewed and approved, how new business requirements reach IT. Today, much of that knowledge lives in people's heads. We are seeking a hands-on business process leader to change that.

As a Business Process Manager, you will own the development and documentation of every business process related to partners. You will capture how work actually gets done today, build a single, trusted source of truth for partner processes, and use it to drive standardization, improvement and automation. You will work closely with the GPO teams, Partner Operations, and our partners to become the go-to expert on how partner work flows across Everpure.

This role is ideal for someone who loves bringing structure to ambiguity, is equally comfortable in a whiteboard session with process owners and in the details of a swimlane diagram, and is motivated by seeing documented processes turn into a better partner experience.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Document the end-to-end partner process landscape

• Build and maintain a partner process inventory, from partner recruitment and onboarding through deal registration, quoting, ordering, programs, incentives and offboarding

• Work with process owners to document current-state policy, process and system flows, including roles and responsibilities (RACI), hand-offs, dependencies, control points and system integrations

• Define and document how exceptions are requested, approved, tracked and closed

• Document how GPO business requirements are captured, prioritized and handed off to Digital Transformation, in partnership with Business Systems Analysts

• Establish process standards and governance

• Create standard templates, notation and naming conventions for process maps, SOPs and work instructions

• Stand up a central, easy-to-find process library and keep it current as programs, policies and systems change

• Define process ownership and a regular review cadence so documentation stays accurate and trusted

• Partner with Partner Operations, Finance, Legal and Internal Audit as needed on policy and control requirements

• Advise process owners and GPO leaders on process design, controls and policy changes

• Drive process improvement

• Identify gaps, redundancies and manual work that create friction for partners, the field or internal teams

• Lead efforts to simplify and standardize core processes and eliminate low-value work

• Identify opportunities for automation and partner self-service, including AI use cases, and help shape requirements for system changes

• Measure process performance (cycle time, exception volume, rework) and track improvements over time

• May lead the work of others on process documentation and improvement projects

• Enable adoption

• Work with the Enablement and Change Management teams to turn documented processes into training, playbooks and partner-facing guidance

• Make sure process changes are communicated clearly to internal teams and partners before they go live

• Support projects and system implementations with process expertise, user acceptance testing input and post-launch reviews

• Provide clear, concise readouts to GPO leadership on process health, risks and priorities

WHAT YOU’LL BRING...

• 6+ years of relevant experie

title: Regulatory Legal Counsel
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

As Regulatory Legal Counsel, EMEA, you will advise on platform, AI and digital regulation that shapes how X, Grok and other SpaceXSI products are built and operated across Europe, the UK, the Middle East and Africa. Europe and the UK have some of the most demanding and actively enforced regulatory regimes we face, including the EU Digital Services Act, the UK Online Safety Act and the EU AI Act. You will turn complex obligations into clear, practical advice and implementation plans, and work hand in hand with Safety, Product, Engineering, Policy, Compliance and our other Legal teams to deliver them.

This role is for someone who enjoys being close to how products actually work, can move quickly between legal analysis and practical implementation, and is comfortable engaging with regulators.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Advise on implementation and compliance with EU, UK and other EMEA digital regulations, with a focus on the EU AI Act, Digital Services Act (DSA), the UK Online Safety Act (OSA), the Audiovisual Media Services Directive (AVMSD) and national implementations such as Ireland's Online Safety Code, and of the eCommerce Directive.

• Support regulatory engagement and investigations with the European Commission, the EU AI Office, Ofcom, Coimisiún na Meán and other regulators, including requests for information, risk assessments, audits, consultations, transparency reporting and enforcement proceedings.

• Work cross-functionally with Safety, Product and Engineering to assess new features and AI products against regulatory requirements, including systemic risk and illegal content risk assessments, age assurance and protection of minors, content moderation and user reporting flows, advertising transparency, researcher data access, and AI transparency and labeling obligations.

• Track and analyze new legislation, codes of practice, guidelines and enforcement trends across EMEA, and explain what they mean for our products in clear, practical terms.

• Help build scalable processes, templates and playbooks for regulatory compliance and product review.

• Partner with Compliance, Product Counsel, Privacy, Litigation and Policy colleagues to keep positions consistent across jurisdictions and regulators.

• Manage outside counsel effectively and cost-consciously.

• Selflessly and generously support what is needed in the legal department, even if it is unfamiliar.

• Adopt daily use of our AI products to accelerate learning and optimize productivity.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Qualified lawyer of good standing ideally UK and/or EU

• Ideally 5+ years of legal experience in technology, platform or digital regulation, at a top-tier law firm, in-house at a technology company, or at a regulator.

• Strong working knowledge of the DSA and/or UK OSA; we don't expect every candidate to have deep experience in every framework listed above, but some combination thereof.

• Strong understanding of the legislative process and the technology industry.

• Exceptional communication skills and the ability to explain complex ideas in a succinct and impactful manner.

Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth , we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. title: Data Science Manager
description:

We are an experienced team of industry experts dedicated to helping readers make smart decisions and choose the right products with ease. Forbes Advisor boasts decades of experience across dozens of geographies and teams, including Content, SEO, Business Intelligence, Finance, HR, Marketing, Production, Technology and Sales. The team brings rich industry knowledge to Forbes Advisor's global coverage of consumer credit, debt, health, home improvement, banking, investing, credit cards, small business, education, insurance, loans, real estate and travel.

Overview

We're looking for a Data Science Manager who can turn commercial problems into scalable Data Science products. You'll work closely with the Director of Data Science to turn our Data Science strategy into scalable products and measurable business outcomes. You'll manage the day-to-day work of a growing team while partnering directly with stakeholders across the business to understand the decisions they're trying to make and identify where Data Science can materially improve the outcome.

This is a player-coach role. You'll lead and develop a growing team of Data Scientists while remaining close enough to the work to shape methodology, review technical outputs and contribute hands-on where needed. Your success won't be measured by how many models the team builds, but by how widely they're used and the commercial impact they create. This is not a research-focused role. Responsibilities

•
Commercial & Decision Science: Work with the Director of Data Science and business and marketing teams to identify high-value opportunities for Data Science, translating commercial problems into predictive models and decision-making products. You'll focus on areas including lifetime value, propensity modelling, customer value, forecasting and performance marketing optimisation, with commercial impact at the centre of how work is prioritised.

•
Scalable Data Science Products: Guide the development of reusable models and methodologies that can scale across products, verticals and use cases rather than repeatedly solving the same problems. You'll take work from experimentation through adoption, ensuring outputs are measurable, explainable and designed around how they'll ultimately be used.

•
Production Data Science: Work closely with Engineering and ML Ops to turn successful modelling work into reliable production products. You'll ensure models have appropriate experimentation, monitoring, retraining and feedback loops, while partnering with technical teams on the infrastructure needed to operate them at scale.

•
Business Partnership & Insight: Build trusted relationships across Marketing, Commercial, Analytics, Product and Engineering. You'll translate business needs into Data Science opportunities and complex modelling into clear recommendations, ensuring the team goes beyond producing predictions to explain what they mean, what we can learn from them and what the business should do next.

•
Team Leadership & Technical Quality: Lead and develop a growing team of Data Scientists while remaining technically close to the work. You'll coach the global team, review modelling approaches and technical outputs, establish consistent standards and contribute hands-on where it adds value. You'll create an environment where technical rigour, curiosity and commercial thinking reinforce one another.

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
ROLE PURPOSE
As Senior Data Analyst, you turn iiDENTIFii ’s data into decisions the business can act on with confidence. Business questions rarely arrive fully formed, so your craft is to shape a broadly worded question into something that can genuinely be answered, answer it well, and land that answer with the people who need to act on it.
This is a senior, hands-on analysis role that sits close to both the business and the data platform. You are comfortable interrogating a messy dataset in the morning and presenting a customer engagement analysis to leadership in the afternoon. You bring analytical depth, sound judgement on data quality and governance, and the communication skill to translate complex findings into decisions non-technical stakeholders can act on.
You work the lifecycle end to end: framing the question, modelling and interrogating the data, drawing out the insight, and seeing the recommendation through to a decision and its adoption. We care more about how well you think, how clearly you communicate and how curious you are about how data is built than about the particular tools you have used before. Strong analysts come from many backgrounds and industries, and we would like to hear from all of them.
What Good Looks Like in the First Six Months

• You own the core business and client reporting, and the definitions behind those numbers are documented, consistent and trusted across teams

• Recurring reporting that is rebuilt by hand today runs to a schedule, with quality checks attached

• At least one piece of analysis you initiated, rather than were asked for, has changed a product, operational or commercial decision

• Product, engineering and commercial treat you as the person to ask about what the data actually says

ROLE TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Reporting, Dashboards & Self-Service

• Own end-to-end reporting for the key business metrics, keeping definitions consistent and trusted across teams

Operational Oversight and Capacity Management: Set daily and weekly priorities across assigned studies and sites, balancing team capacity with participant visits, sponsor timelines, monitoring activity, and database milestones. Identify risks early and adjust plans to maintain service levels.

Data Quality and Compliance Governance: Maintain quality control practices for source review, EDC/CRF transcription, reconciliation, and documentation. Review performance trends and confirm activities align with protocol, GCP, sponsor requirements, and Care Access procedures.

• Track integration progress, critical dependencies, and blockers against transaction objectives, escalating issues and driving timely resolution as needed

• Identify opportunities to improve, standardize, and scale M&A finance processes, tools, templates, and governance, while building strong relationships and influencing effectively across a matrixed organization

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field

• 9+ years of relevant experience in M&A finance, transaction advisory, strategic finance, corporate finance, FP&A, and/or finance integration

Scientific Games is the global leader in lottery games, sports betting and technology, and the partner of choice for government lotteries. SG Lottery is looking for a self-motivated, experienced Technical Operations Engineer to join a Technical Operations team that supports our lottery solutions. title: Head of Capital
description:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

The opportunity

We are looking for a Head of Capital to run how Relay raises equity and works with its investors: the next round and the ones after it, from the investor map to the close, next to the CEO.

Relay is a technology enabled parcel carrier - we deliver parcels from retailers to end customers but do it much more efficiently than incumbents. This efficiency has propelled us into one of the fastest growing companies in Europe - we have grown over 40x in the last 18 months. The capital Relay raises decides how fast the network grows and what it can promise retailers. Raising it well, from the right investors, on terms we understand, is a job in its own right.

About the role

The capital we raise next decides how fast the network grows and what it can promise retailers. Our next round is planned for Q2/Q3 2027. It is for growth, from growth-stage investors, and it will be won on evidence. Today a raise runs through the CEO and the CFO alongside their day jobs. It works. It is however, not a system.

You will be the person who makes it one. You will not just be the person who holds and runs the Series C transaction, but also be the Head of the Office that will build the systems to raise multiple rounds of capital in the future. Between rounds you keep the map, the materials and the investors warm, so each raise starts from a record, not a blank page. Few roles let you own how a growing company raises the capital it runs on, from the inside, round after round.

Who you work with

- CEO: you report here. The CEO pitches and takes the decisions on a round.

- CFO: you work together daily. The CFO owns the budget, the forecast, internal finance and any debt. You own equity, the investors behind it, and the investor-facing model built from the CFO's numbers - never a second set.

- Co-founder and the Extended Leadership Team: the proof a round needs.

- External & Internal Counsel: terms and the close.

- Board: updates between rounds and approval on the round.

What you'll do

Running the transaction with the CEO & CFO

1. Build the investor map: which funds, which partner at each, why each fits us, in what order we go, and the warm path to each.

2. The process start to close: the timeline, outreach, a brief before every meeting and notes after, investor questions answered within a day, and diligence.

3. Put term sheets side by side and show what each costs in the round after. Draw up illustrative analysis and counsel the CEO on the right strategy.

4. Hold the story in one version, drafted with the CEO. The same claims and numbers across the deck, the model and the data room.

5. Own the investor-facing model: scenarios, unit economics and use of funds. Every number ties to one the CFO has signed.

Between rounds

1. Refresh the deck, the KPI pack and the data room every quarter.

2. Write investor and board updates. Answer existing investors' questions. Track what we promised them.

title: Counsel
description:
COUNSEL OPPORTUNITY

COUNSEL - eDiscovery & Information Governance

Redgrave LLP is seeking a Counsel with 5-10 years of experience leading eDiscovery workstreams in complex litigation and investigations. This position is fully remote, with some travel expected; an active license may be required in a state where the Firm has an office.This role partners with clients and merits counsel to deliver practical, defensible discovery strategy at the intersection of eDiscovery, information governance, and data privacy.

The Opportunity

In this role, you will take ownership of discovery-focused workstreams, draft sophisticated written work product, and help teams execute efficient, defensible solutions. You will be client-facing and will collaborate directly with merits counsel, co-counsel, experts, and internal teams.

Responsibilities

• Lead eDiscovery and information-governance workstreams in complex litigation and investigations.

• Draft and review discovery and governance work product, including legal memoranda, correspondence, protective orders, ESI agreements, motions, playbook components, and defensibility memoranda.

• Prepare outlines and talking points for client meetings, custodian interviews, meet-and-confers, and motion hearings.

• Coordinate with merits counsel, co-counsel, and experts; support expert task/matter management and preparation for oral testimony as needed.

• Provide practical legal advice to Firm teams; monitor emerging law and support training/policy development.

• Coach and mentor junior team members; contribute to cohesive, high-performing teams.

• Support thought leadership and practice development initiatives; identify opportunities to expand client relationships.

Qualifications

• Juris Doctor (J.D.) and active U.S. bar admission (additional admissions obtained as needed).

• 5-10 years of experience managing eDiscovery in complex litigation and investigations.

• Excellent legal writing and research skills; proven ability to draft complex discovery documents and memoranda.

• Strong project leadership and client-facing communication skills; comfort working directly with merits counsel and co-counsel.

• Technology-forward mindset and proficiency with Microsoft Office; ability to quickly learn and leverage litigation support tools.

• Willingness to travel as needed (including international travel depending on assignment).

Preferred

• Experience advising on information governance and/or data privacy issues in the litigation/investigation context.

• Experience developing defensibility positions or playbooks; participation in industry organizations and thought leadership.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

• Occasionally lifts objects weighing up to 10 pounds

• Frequently reaches and grasps with arms and hands; occasionally stoops and bends; must have manual dexterity

• Ability to closely examine and inspect materials

• Ability to identify and distinguish colors

• Ability to travel as needed

• Frequently uses a keyboard to enter or transform words or data

• Work is generally performed in a remote office environment with an occasional requirement to work in a normal office environment

BENEFITS

Redgrave LLP is committed to supporting our employees and ensuring their needs are met beyond the workplace. We offer a flexible portfolio of benefits and services, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) plan, additional benefits to help you prepare for retirement, free access to Employee Assistance Programs, and other programs designed to help you and your family stay healthy, feel secure, and enjoy a positive work/life balance.

title: Commercial Sales Development Representative
description:
About Delinea:
Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. It extends privileged access management from the point of access to the moment of action, using just-in-time authorization to reduce standing privilege across on-premises, multi-cloud and short-lived infrastructure, without adding friction for legitimate users. Delinea provides visibility across every identity type, scores the risk each one carries, and preserves the context behind access decisions, making them auditable and defensible. It supports both static and ephemeral access, letting teams apply Zero Standing Privilege where risk demands it without replacing existing infrastructure.

Position Summary:

The Commercial Sales Development Representative (C-SDR) at Delinea is a full-time, hybrid, position based at our Boston location (100 Summer Street). As an entry-level position, this role serves as a vital connection between our Sales and Marketing teams, focusing on generating and qualifying leads to create business opportunities. The Commercial SDR is responsible for initiating communication with potential customers, understanding their needs, and setting the stage for a successful sales process.

title: Account Manager - Performance Marketing (Remote Global)
description:
Description
Overview
We are looking for a Client Success Manager (Performance Marketing) to join our growing global team. In this role, you will own a portfolio of client accounts end-to-end: setting account strategy, guiding success plans tied to business KPIs, driving growth opportunities, and proactively managing retention and risk. Your portfolio will include paid media-driven accounts as well as SEO-focused accounts. The ideal candidate combines marketing strategy thinking with strong client communication, ties every decision to client ROI, and can lead cross-functional specialists (Paid Search, Paid Social, SEO, DSP, Creative, Analytics) toward clear priorities and outcomes.
This is a remote role open to candidates willing to work US business hours.
Responsibilities

• Own account strategy and success planning: define goals, KPIs, priorities, and quarterly roadmaps with each client.

• Lead client relationship and communication: run recurring meetings, manage stakeholders, align expectations from day one, and document next steps.

• Drive account performance management: interpret results against business metrics (ROAS, CPA, CAC vs. LTV, organic growth), identify issues and opportunities, and coordinate actions with channel owners.

• Identify and scope account growth opportunities: expansions, tests, and new initiatives tied to performance signals and client objectives.

• Manage account health, retention, renewal, and risk: flag risks early, create mitigation plans, and ensure consistent value delivery across a multi-client portfolio.

Why Join Finch

• Work globally, stay flexible: Join a fully distributed team across the US, LATAM, Europe, and APAC.

• Meaningful impact from day one: Your work directly influences client outcomes and how Finch grows.

• A culture built on curiosity, transparency, and ownership: We share context and empower people to make decisions.

• High-caliber teammates: Collaborate with specialists in Paid Search, Paid Social, SEO, DSP, Creative, Analytics, and more.

• Learning as a default: We encourage experimentation, cross-training, and growth as the company scales.

• Real work-life balance: We value high performance, not overwork.

Requirements
We’re looking for:

• 5+ years of experience as an Account Manager or Client Success Manager in a performance marketing or digital marketing agency (required).

• Acted as the primary point of contact (POC) for multiple client accounts simultaneously (required).

• Strong understanding of performance marketing fundamentals: paid advertising, attribution, KPIs, and optimization logic (required).

• Experience working with paid advertising-driven accounts across Paid Search, Paid Social, and Programmatic/DSP (required).

• Proven track record of improving client retention or growing accounts, with concrete examples (required).

• Fluent English, written and spoken, and comfortable leading strategic conversations with senior client stakeholders (required).

• Availability to work with consistent overlap with US business hours. (required)

• Background managing SEO-driven accounts or hands-on SEO experience (advantage).

• Experience working with US or international clients (advantage).
